To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we present a novel approach to skill composition that combines hierarchical reinforcement learning with formal methods, and that our approach allows for zero-shot composition and is robust to domain changes.

(1) We present a method to compose new skills from existing skills without any additional learning; (2) Our method can be used to compose skills in a hierarchical manner; (3) Our method can also be used to learn a meta-controller that can select between a number of skills; (4) Our method can learn skills in a hierarchical way; and (5) Our method can combine skills to solve tasks.

we present a framework that allows for the specification of tasks with a logical language, learns hierarchical policies with well-defined intrinsic reward using any RL methods, and is able to compose skills from existing ones with minimal learning.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: (i) the design of a hierarchical RL framework that allows for the convenient composition of tasks using logical expressions and (ii) the development of a framework that can learn hierarchical policies and construct new policies from existing ones without the need for additional training.
